title: Target comparison assembled from counit restriction and apex transport
statement: For a cartesian square f,g,g′,f′ and V,W with W⊆g⁻¹V, there exists a natural target restriction isomorphism b satisfying the pinned degree-zero comparison equation with the explicitly constructed source isomorphism openPinnedSingleDegreeZeroSourceIso. This theorem is proved from counit restriction, isomorphic apex transport and the existing bare base-change calculation. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-fibre-product], [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons], [def-pc-open-pinned-single-degree-zero-source], [lem-pc-n3-open-base-change-calculation], [lem-pc-open-pinned-single-degree-zero-apex], [lem-pc-open-pinned-single-degree-zero-counit].

source.place: Tags 08HY (mate construction), 08FE (open direct image), 08DW (pullback restriction); inherited argument of lem-pc-open-pinned-single-degree-zero-square.

proof.text: Use Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE to restrict the cartesian square and its isoPullback to identify the apex with the chosen pullback. Obtain t from the counit square. Whisker the explicit direct-image comparison and t to construct b₀. Use the existing bare base-change calculation and direct-image comparison naturality to move the counit through b₀. Cancel the constructed pullback comparison using the counit square. Prove and use base-change naturality to move the single restriction map to the source. Compose b₀ with the isomorphic apex target comparison and use its component equation.

theorem open_pinned_single_degree_zero_target
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    ∃ b : singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} g' f' 0 ⋙
        (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⋙
        singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} (pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)) 0,
    ∀ G : X.Modules,
      (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite f g g' f' sq.w 0 G) ≫ b.hom.app G =
        (openPinnedSingleDegreeZeroSourceIso f g V W hWV).hom.app G ≫
          singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)
            (pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))
            (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)) pullback.condition 0
            ((schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).obj G)
